summary_1line: Death, sent by Brahma, tells Rama his divine mission is fulfilled and reminds him of his origin as Vishnu who incarnated to destroy Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ascetic revealing himself as Death stands before Rama in a guarded chamber while Lakshmana waits outside the closed door.
Death proclaims Rama as the cosmic Vishnu from whose navel a radiant lotus emerges bearing Brahma.
